topic: Expert C++ Implementation Concept: Name Lookup and the Impact of Nested Classes
explanation: This delves into the intricacies of C++ name lookup, particularly focusing on how the compiler resolves names within nested classes, impacting both compile time and runtime performance.  The process involves a complex sequence of steps including argument-dependent lookup (ADL), and the order in which different scopes are searched.  Understanding this is crucial for writing efficient and predictable code, avoiding unexpected behavior and subtle bugs related to name hiding and ambiguity.  The compiler's implementation relies on sophisticated symbol tables and potentially optimized search algorithms.
